name: Atalan Jackal

bonuses.name: Mounted
bonuses.text: By default, an Atalan Jackal is mounted on a Dirtcycle (see Church of Steel).

bonuses.name: Passes For Human
bonuses.text: A DN 3 Awareness (Int) Test is required to notice an Atalan Jackal is not Human.

bonuses.name: Raiders
bonuses.text: When this Threat makes a ranged attack test against a target within 6m, that target is Vulnerable.

bonuses.name: Skilled Outriders
bonuses.text: If this Threat is Mounted and moves on its Turn it gains +1 Defence until the start of its next Turn.

abilities.name: Jackal Manoeuvre
abilities.text: If Mounted, this Threat can move and attack as a single Ruin Action.

abilities.name: Unquestioning Loyalty
abilities.text: When a Threat with the GENESTEALER CULT and PSYKER Keywords within 6m of this Threat is targeted by a ranged attack, this Threat may interpose themself as a reaction and become the new target for the attack. If this Threat is mounted, the range of this Reaction is half the Speed of the vehicle.

options.name: Jackal Options
options.text: An Atalan Jackal may be equipped with either a Hand Cannon or a Shotgun from the Wrath & Glory Rulebook. In a mob of 4 or more Atalan Jackals, one may wield a Grenade Launcher, one may exchange their Blasting charge for a Demolition Charge (profile below) and one may ride a Wolfquad (Church of Steel) instead of a Dirtcycle.

note: Defence printed '3 (6 Mounted)' (stored 3) and Speed '6 / 38 (Mounted)' (stored 6). Blasting Charge prints 'Thrown Sx4' (stored [12], Strength 3 x 4) and 'Blast 4'. Mounted Dirtcycle and Wolfquad are Church of Steel vehicle-format, not transcribed.
